title: Optimal algorithmic complexity of inference in quantum kernel methods
abstract: arXiv:2604.15214v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Quantum kernel methods are among the leading candidates for achieving quantum advantage in supervised learning. A key bottleneck is the cost of inference: evaluating a trained model on new data requires estimating a weighted sum $\sum_{i=1}^N \alpha_i k(x,x_i)$ of $N$ kernel values to additive precision $\varepsilon$, where $\alpha$ is the vector of trained coefficients. The standard approach estimates each term independently via sampling, yielding a query complexity of $O(N\lVert\alpha\rVert_2^2/\varepsilon^2)$. In this work, we identify two independent axes for improvement: (1) How individual kernel values are estimated (sampling versus quantum amplitude estimation), and (2) how the sum is approximated (term-by-term versus via a single observable), and systematically analyze all combinations thereof. translated_title: 量子核方法中推理的最优算法复杂度
translated_abstract: 量子核方法是在监督学习中实现量子优势的主要候选方案之一。其关键瓶颈在于推理成本：在训练好的模型上对新数据进行评估，需要在加性精度 $\varepsilon$ 下估计由 $N$ 个核值构成的加权和 $\sum_{i=1}^N \alpha_i k(x,x_i)$，其中 $\alpha$ 是训练得到的系数向量。标准方法通过对每一项独立采样进行估计，产生 $O(N\lVert\alpha\rVert_2^2/\varepsilon^2)$ 的查询复杂度。在本工作中，我们识别出两个相互独立的改进维度：（1）如何估计单个核值（采样与量子振幅估计），（2）如何近似该求和（逐项求和与通过单个可观测量），并系统地分析了所有可能的组合。查询复杂度最优的组合将完整的推理求和编码为单个可观测量的期望值，并应用量子振幅估计……
tldr: 该论文通过将完整推理求和编码为单个可观测量的期望值并结合量子振幅估计，实现了量子核方法推理的最优查询复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper achieves the optimal query complexity for inference in quantum kernel methods by encoding the full inference sum as the expectation value of a single observable combined with quantum amplitude estimation.
